29:46: Ur ţnamaret At Tezmamt, siwa s wawal aẓidan, siwa wid degsen idensen. Init: "numen s wayen id irsen ɣuṛneɣ, id irsen ɣuṛwen. Ṛebbi nneɣ, akked Ṛebbi nnwen, Yiwen. Nekwni ɣuṛeS d imḍuɛen".
29:47: Akka ay ed Nessers, ɣuṛek, Tazmamt. Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, umnen yis. Ger wigi, kra umnen yis. I inekṛen issekniyen nneɣ, siwa ijehliyen.
29:48: Ur telliḍ temmaleḍ kra n Tezmamt, uqbel tagi; ur ţ teţţaruḍ, s uyeffus ik. Yili ad cukken inekkaṛen.
29:49: Xaṭi, neţţa d issekniyen iberrzen, deg idmaren n wid iwumi teţţunefk tmusni. Siwa imednas, i inekṛen issekniyen nneɣ.
29:50: Nnan: "a lemmer id rsen fellas, issekniyen sɣuṛ Mass is"! Ini: "issekniyen ar Ṛebbi kan. Nek, d aneddaṛ kan, iţbegginen".
29:51: Neɣ, ur steqnaɛen ara s trusi ɣuṛek, sɣuṛneɣ, n Tezmamt, malen asen ţ. Deg waya, s tideţ, aḥunu, akked usmekti i ugdud iumnen.
29:52: Ini: "Iqadd Ṛebbi, d anagi gari yidwen. Issen i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Wid iumnen di tkerkas, u ugin Ṛebbi, widak d imexsuṛen".
29:53: Sḥirin k ɣef uɛaqeb. Lemmer mačči d lajel iţwassnen, a ten id ias uɛaqeb. Ih, a ten id ias, deqzalla, ur bnin.
29:54: Sḥirin k ɣef uɛaqeb. Ih, Loahennama a ţţezzi i ijehliyen
29:55: Ass ideg ar asen isbur uɛaqeb, sennig sen, akw seddaw iḍaṛen nnsen, ad Yini: "jeṛṛbet ayen txeddmem".
29:56: A yimdanen iW iumnen, niɣ tamurt iW tewsaɛ. Ihi, ɛabdet iyI, Nek.
29:57: Yal iman, ad ijeṛṛeb tameţţant; sinna, ɣuṛneɣ a d tuɣalem.
29:58: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad asen Nerr tanezduɣt di Loennet m tɣuṛfatin, ddaw as isaffen ţţazzalen, degs ad wekkṛen. D asaɛdi warraz n wid ixedmen lxiṛ,
29:60: Acḥal n lewḥuc, ur d neţţawi ṛṛeẓq nnsen. Ṛebbi Iṛeẓq iten, u Iṛeẓq ikwen. Neţţa, Issel, d Amusnaw.
29:61: Ma testeqṣaḍ ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, i Inuben s yiṭij akked waggur"? A d inin, war ccekk: "d Ṛebbi". Ihi, acimi wexxṛen?
29:62: Ṛebbi Issugut lɣit i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, u Iwezzen as. Ih, Ṛebbi Issen yal cci.
29:63: Ma testeqṣaḍ ten: "anwa id Isseɣlayen aman seg igenni, Issidir yissen akal, deffir tmeţţant is"? A d inin, war ccekk, "d Ṛebbi". Ini: "ccekṛan i Ṛebbi". Maca, tegwti degsen, ur fhimen.
29:64: Tameddurt agi, di ddunit, siwa lhawiyya, d wurar. D axxam aneggaru, war ccekk, ay d amuddir, lemmer ẓṛin.
29:65: Mara rekben di lbabuṛ, ad naɛṛen Ṛebbi, d idiniyen zeddigen ɣuṛeS. Mi ten Isellek ar lberr, atnan la ţcaraken.
29:66: Ad nekṛen ayen i sen Nefka, ad zhun, deqqal ad ẓṛen.
29:67: Day ur walan ara, Nerra loamaɛ n laman, wanag la ţwaxḍafen imdanen i sen d izzin? Day ad amnen di tkerkas, u ad nekṛen lɣit n Ṛebbi?
29:68: Anwa i idensen kteṛ: win id isnulfan tikerkas af Ṛebbi, neɣ win irran tideţ d tikerkas, mi t id tusa? Day mačči d Loahennama ay d tanezduɣt i ijehliyen?
29:69: Wid ijuhden ar loiha nneɣ, a ten Nenhu, war ccekk, s iberdan nneɣ. Ih, Ṛebbi Iţţili ar lɛuṣam.
30:3: deg wakal aqṛib maḍi. Deffir lexsaṛa nnsen, ad rnun,
30:4: di kra iseggwasen. Lameṛ ar Ṛebbi, uqbel aya, u ssyen ɣeṛ da. Assen, ad feṛḥen lmumnin
30:5: s rrbeḥ n Ṛebbi. Isserbaḥ win i S ihwan. Neţţa, d Uzmir, Iţḥunu.
30:6: D lemɛahda n Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi ur Iţxallaf ara lemɛahda S, maca, tegwti n medden ur ssinen.
30:7: Ssnen ayen id innunnten, di tmeddurt n ddunit. ɣef laxeṛt nitni stehzan.
30:8: Day ur meyyzen ara deg iman nnsen? Ur Ixliq Ṛebbi tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, siwa s tideţ, akked lajel iţwassnen. Ih, aṭas n medden i inekṛen timlilit d Mass nnsen.
30:9: Day ur unagen ara di tmurt, ad walin amek teḍṛa d wid i ten id izwaren? Llan ifen ten tazmert, ɣzan tamurt, ɣelben ten akken i ţ ɛamṛen. Usan ten id imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen. Ur ten Idnis Ṛebbi. Maca d nitni i idensen iman nnsen.
30:10: Dɣa teqseḥ taggara n laɛṛuṛ. Skaddben issekniyen n Ṛebbi. Pmmaɛliken fellasen.
30:11: Ṛebbi Inezzu lxelq; sinna, Iţţales it id. Sinna, ɣuṛeS ara tuɣalem.
30:12: Ass ideg ara d ijbu yimir, ad feqɛen ibeɣwḍiyen.
30:13: Ur ten ţselliken wid ţcaraken. Ad nekṛen wid ţcaraken.
30:14: Ass ideg ara d ijbu yimir, assen ad mfaṛaqen.
30:15: Wanag wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ad zhun di tebḥirt.
30:16: Ma d wid ijehlen, inekṛen issekniyen nneɣ, akked temlilit n laxeṛt, widak ar uɛaqeb ara rsen.
30:17: Gedha s Ṛebbi, tameddit nnwen, taṣebḥit nnwen!
30:18: I Neţţa ccekṛan, di tmurt akked igenwan, tameddit u di ţnaṣfa n wass.
30:19: Issuffuɣ ed amuddir si lmegget. Issuffuɣ ed lmegget seg umuddir. Issidir akal, deffir tmeţţant is. Akka ara d teffɣem.
30:20: Seg issekniyen iS: Ixelq ikwen seg wakal. Aql akwen d imdanen tembwezzɛam.
30:21: Seg issekniyen iS: Ixelq awen, segwen, tiɛggaltin nnwen, a ţzedɣem yidsent. Irra garawen tayri, lmaḥnana. Deg waya, s tideţ, issekniyen i ugdud iţmeyyizen.
30:22: Seg issekniyen iS: lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan, amgirred ger tutlayin nnwen, akked initen nnwen. Deg waya, s tideţ, issekniyen i imusnawen.
30:23: Seg issekniyen iS: iḍes nnwen deg iḍ, deg wass, anadi nnwen n lfeḍl iS. Deg waya, s tideţ, issekniyen i ugdud isellen.
30:24: Seg issekniyen iS: Issenɛat awen lebṛaq, degs tugdi, asirem. Issadar ed aman seg igenni, Issidir yissen akal, deffir tmeţţant is. Deg waya, s tideţ, issekniyen i ugdud ifehmen.
30:25: Seg issekniyen iS: s lameṛ iS, igenni akked tmurt bedden. Sinna, ma Isawel awen d, yiwen usiwel, seg wakal kunwi a d teffɣem.
30:26: IneS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Akken ma llan, unzen aS.
30:27: D Neţţa i Inezzun lxelq, sinna Iţţales it id. D ayen i S isehlen maḍi. IneS umedya aɛlayan, di tmurt akked igenwan. Neţţa d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
30:28: Ibbwi yawen d amedya, seg iman nnwen: day tcerkem d waklan nnwen, ayen i s ikwen Nɣat, dɣa tɛadlem yidsen? Day ten teţţagwadem, akken teţţemyagwadem garawen? Akka ay Neţfeṣṣil issekniyen i ugdud iţxemmimen.
30:29: Xaṭi! Wid idensen teddun d lhawiyyat nnsen, ur ssinen. Anwa ara inhun wid Itlef Ṛebbi? Ur sɛin imɛiwnen.
30:30: Smil udem ik adini ar tideţ, d lxelq n Ṛebbi akken id Ixleq imdanen. Ur illi ubeddel, di lxelq n Ṛebbi. Wagi d ddin amxallef, maca, tegwti n medden ur ssinen.
30:31: D imḍuɛen iS, ḥezzbet aS, beddet i tẓallit, ur ţţilit seg wid iţcaraken,
30:32: seg wid ifeṛqen ddin nnsen. Uɣalen d ṭayfat, yal akabar icṛeḥ s wayen isɛa.
30:33: Imdanen, ma iwwet iten wugur, ad naɛṛen Mass nnsen, d imḍuɛen iS. Sinna, ma Isḥess asen aḥunu, sɣuṛeS, a ţwaliḍ arbaɛ degsen ţcaraken i Mass nnsen,
30:34: iwakken ad nekṛen i sen Nefka. Zhut! Deqqal a ţţeẓṛem.
30:35: Neɣ Nessader asen ed amḍebbeṛ, i iţmeslayen ɣef wayen i S ţcaraken.
30:36: Mi Nesḥess aḥunu i imdanen, ad ceṛḥen yis. Ma tḥuza ten tucmiţ, seg wayen id urwen ifassen nnsen, ad aysen.
30:37: Day ur walan ara ar Ṛebbi Issugut ṛṛeẓq i win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen. Deg waya, s tideţ, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
30:38: Efk as leḥqq is i llezm ik, i umeɣbun, i win id ibbwi ubrid. Pţif akka i wid ibɣan udem n Ṛebbi. D widak ay d imerbaḥ.
30:39: Ayen teţţakem n rrba, iwakken ad issemɣweṛ ayla n medden, ar Ṛebbi ur issimɣuṛ ara. Ayen teţzekkim ɣef udem n Ṛebbi, d ayen ara ibuṛekten.
30:40: Ṛebbi, ikwen id Ixelqen, sinna, ikwen Iɣaten, sinna, ara kwen Inɣen, sinna, ara kwen id Issidren. Day ara ixdem kra, seg waya, yiwen seg wid teţcarakem? Gedha s yiS, Aɛlayan sennig wid ţcaraken!
30:41: Iḍehṛ ed lefsad di lberr u di yill seg wayen id urwen ifassen n medden, iwakken ad Isukk fellasen kra seg wayen xedmen, amar a d uɣalen s abrid.
30:42: Ini: "iniget di tmurt, muqlet amek teḍṛa d imezwura. Tegwti, segsen, ţcaraken".
30:43: Err udem ik ar ddin amxallef, uqbel a d ias sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, ass ur neţwexxiṛ. Assen, ad ţwaferzen.
30:44: Win ijehlen, tijehli s mgal is; wid ixeddmen ayen ilhan, gemren i iman nnsen.
30:45: Iwakken ad Ikafi, s lfeḍl iS, wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan. Neţţa, s tideţ, ur Iḥemmel ara ijehliyen.
30:46: Seg issekniyen iS: Iţţazen ed aḍu abcir, ad awen Isḥess, cwiṭ, seg uḥunu S; ad iaɛjel lbabuṛ, s lameṛ iS. A ţnadim lfeḍl iS, amar a ţţesnemmrem.
30:47: Niɣ Nuzen ed, uqbel ik, imazanen i igduden nnsen. Usan ten id, s ubeggen. Nerra d ţţaṛ seg wid ibeɣwḍen. Aslak n lmumnin d lwaoeb nneɣ.
30:48: Ṛebbi, id Iţţaznen aḍu isselḥayen asigna, a t ifser, deg igenni, akken i S ihwa, a t Issemfaṛeq, a ţwaliḍ ageffur a d iteffeɣ segs. Mi t Issaweḍ ar wid i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, a ten tafeḍ ceṛḥen.
30:49: Wanag, iuɣ lḥal, llan uysen, uqbel ad asen d iɣli.
30:50: Wali lateṛ uḥunu n Ṛebbi: amek id Issidir akal, deffir tmeţţant is. Ih, d Win, s tideţ, i Issidiren lmeggtin. Neţţa Izmer i yal cci.
30:51: Mara Nazen aḍu, ara walin iţţiwṛiɣ, a ţdum, deffir es, tjehli nnsen.
30:52: Ma d kečč, s tideţ, ur tezmireḍ a ţţerreḍ lmeggtin ad slen, neɣ iɛeẓẓugen ad slen i tnaɛṛit, ma uɣalen ɣer deffir.
30:53: Ur tezmireḍ a ţenhuḍ iderɣalen, mgal ttelfan nnsen. Ara terreḍ ad ak slen, siwa wid iumnen s issekniyen nneɣ. Nitni d imḍuɛen.
30:54: Ṛebbi, ikwen Ixelqen si ṛehfan; sinna, deffir ṛehfan, Irra tazmert; sinna, deffir tezmert, Irra ṛehfan, akked ccib. Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Neţţa d Amusnaw, d Aḥernuk.
30:55: Ass ideg ara d ijbu yimir, ad gallen ibeɣwḍiyen, ar siwa saɛa segmi mmuten. Akka ay skiddiben.
30:56: Ad inin wid iwumi teţţunefk tussna, akked liman: "niɣ teqqimem di Tezmamt n Ṛebbi, ar ass n tnekra. Wagi d ass n tnekra, maca tellam ur tessinem".
30:57: Assen, wid idensen, ur ten teţsellik nndama neɣ asuter n ssmaḥ.
30:58: Niɣ Nefka, i medden, yal amedya di Leqwṛan agi. Maca, mi sen d tebbwiḍ assekni, ad ak inin, war ccekk, wid ijehlen: "kunwi d wid ireoonen".
30:59: Akka i Iselleɣ Ṛebbi ulawen n wid ur nessin.
30:60: Eṣbeṛ, ih, lemɛahda n Ṛebbi d tideţ. Ur k sḥirin, wid ur neţţutebbet!
31:3: d nnhaya u d aḥunu i iɛaṛḍiyen,
31:4: wid ibedden i tẓallit, iţzekkin, iţţutebbten af laxeṛt.
31:5: Wigi, di nnhaya sɣuṛ Mass nnsen. Wigi, d isaɛdiyen.
31:6: Ger yimdanen, wid iţţaɣen awal n zzhu, iwakken ad nnetlafen seg ubrid n Ṛebbi, war tamusni. U fellas ttihin. I wigi, aɛaqeb isdullun.
31:7: Ma mlan as issekniyen nneɣ, ad ibren s temɣweṛ, amzun ur asen isli, amzun ɛaẓgen as imeẓẓuɣen. Xebbeṛ it s uɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
31:8: Ih, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, leonanat isaɛdiyen.
31:9: Degsen ad wekkṛen. Lemɛahda n Ṛebbi d tideţ. Neţţa d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
31:10: Ixleq igenwan, war tigejda ara twalim. Irra di tmurt idurar, iwakken ur teţzenzil ara yiswen. Iwezzaɛ, degs, yal lxelq. Nessader ed aman seg igenni. Nessemɣi d degs, yal tayuga tukyist.
31:11: Wagi d lxelq n Ṛebbi. Sseknet iyi d, acu d xelqen wid ur nelli d Neţţa. Xaṭi, imednas atnan di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ.
31:12: Niɣ Nefka i Luqman ṣṣwab: "snemmer Ṛebbi. Win isnemmiren, isnemmir kan i iman is. Ma d wid ijehlen, ihi, Ṛebbi d Asɛay, d Amaɛzuz".
31:13: Mi inna Luqman i mmi s, la t isselmad: "a mmi! Ur ţcarak i Ṛebbi. Ccerk, s tideţ, d ddens abarar".
31:14: Nweṣṣa amdan ɣef imawlan is. Imma s temḥen s tadist is. Tuṭḍa s, sin iseggwasen. Snemmer iyI, u i imawlan ik. Tuɣalin ɣuṛI.
31:15: Ma ḥeţţmen fellak, ad iyI tcarkeḍ ayen ur tessineḍ, ur asen teddu di lebɣi. Illi yidsen d uwqim di ddunit. Ddu d ubrid n wid isteṛoɛen ɣuṛI. Sinna, tuɣalin nnwen ɣuṛI, ad awen Mleɣ ayen txeddmem.
31:16: "Ih, a mmi, xas am taẓeyt uɛaqqa ucceryad, ara yilin di teẓṛut, neɣ deg igenwan, neɣ di tmurt, a ţ id Iawi Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi d Laṭif, Iẓṛa.
31:17: A mmi, bedd i tẓallit, ameṛ lewqama, ṭṭixxeṛ i wayen n dir, eṣbeṛ i wayen ara k id iasen! Aya, s tideţ, seg uɛzzem i lumuṛ.
31:18: Ur sxunzuṛ ar medden, ur teddu di tmurt s ṭṭɣaya! Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Iḥemmel yal imnefxi, amzuxi.
31:19: Iṛqiq di tikli k, ssers ṣṣut ik! Niɣ ṣṣut ucmit maḍi, d win n yeɣyal".
31:20: Day ur twalam ara, Inub Ṛebbi fellawen s wayen akw illan deg igenwan, akked wayen illan di tmurt? Isserwa yawen lɣit iS, uḍhiṛ, uffir. U llan lɣaci i iţnamaren ɣef Ṛebbi, war tamusni, neɣ nnhaya, neɣ Tazmamt timnewweṛt.
31:21: Ma nnan asen: "ddut akked wayen id Issader Ṛebbi", a d inin: "xaṭi, a neddu akked wayen id nufa ar imezwura nneɣ". I ma Cciṭan atan la ten inecced ar uɛaqeb n tmes?
31:22: Win ifkan i Ṛebbi udem amḍuɛ, u neţţa d aɛeṛḍi, iṭṭef deg ufus iṣeḥḥan maḍi. Ar Ṛebbi, tuɣalin n lumuṛ.
31:23: Win ijehlen, ur k tɣwebben tjehli s! ɣuṛneɣ, tuɣalin nnsen; ad asen Nini acu xedmen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iẓṛa i illan deg idmaren.
31:24: A ten Neoo ad zhun cwiṭ, sinna, a Nḥeţţem fellasen aɛaqeb iwaɛṛen.
31:25: Ma testeqṣaḍ ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan"? A d inin, war ccekk: "d Ṛebbi". Ini: "ccekṛan i Ṛebbi". Maca, tegwti degsen, ur ssinen.
31:26: I Ṛebbi i illan akw di tmurt akked igenwan. Ih, Ṛebbi d Asɛay, d Amaɛzuz.
31:27: Xas lukan ttjuṛ akw n ddunit d leqlamat, u yill, ernu yas ṣa ilellen nniḍen, d lmidad nnsen, ur ţqamen awalen n Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
31:28: Lxelq nnwen, tanekra nnwen, amzun d yiman yiwen kan. Ih, Ṛebbi Issel, Iţwali.
31:29: Day ur twalaḍ ara, Ṛebbi Issekcam iḍ deg wass, Issekcam ass deg yiḍ. Iḥeţţem i yiṭij akked waggur ad lḥun, ar lajel iţwassnen. Ih, Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen txeddmem.
31:30: Akka, acku Ṛebbi d Tideţ. Ayen uɣuṛ naɛṛen, war Neţţa, d tikerkas. Ṛebbi, d Aɛlayan, d Ameqwṛan.
31:31: Day ur twalaḍ ara ssfina, teţţazal di yill s lqwedṛa n Ṛebbi, iwakken ad awen d Issenɛat seg issekniyen iS. Ih, deg wayagi, issekniyen i yal aṣebṛi isnemmiren.
31:32: Ma tesbur asen lmuja, am tillas, ad nujen ar Ṛebbi, ɣuṛeS s ddin azedgan. Mi ten Isellek ar lberr, kra, degsen, ṭṭfen deg wawal nnsen. I inekṛen issekniyen nneɣ, siwa yal axeddaɛ ajehli.
31:33: A yimdanen! Ḥezzbet i Mass nnwen. Agwadet ass ideg ababat ur d ilehhu d mmi s, u mmi s ur d ilehhu d baba s, s wacemma. Ih, lemɛahda n Ṛebbi, d tideţ. Ur kwen teţɣuṛṛu tmeddurt n ddunit. Ur kwen issefṛaɣ imɣweṛṛi, ɣef Ṛebbi.
31:34: Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ɣuṛeS tamusni n yimir. Issadar ed ageffur. Iẓṛa i illan di tɛabbuḍin. Ur iẓṛi yiwen acu ara ikseb azekka; ur iẓṛi yiwen anwa akal ideg ara immet. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iẓṛa, d Amusnaw.
32:2: Tarusi n Tezmamt, ur illi degs ccekk, sɣuṛ Mass imaḍalen.
32:3: Neɣ a d inin: "isnulfa ţ id". Xaṭi, neţţat, d tideţ sɣuṛ Mass ik, iwakken a ţnedṛeḍ agdud uɣuṛ ur d iusi ara uneddaṛ, uqbel ik, amar ad ţwanhun.
32:4: Ṛebbi i Ixelqen tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, di sdis wussan; sinna, Iɛannec ɣef usgeld. Ur tesɛim, war Neţţa, bab, neɣ amcafaɛ. Day ula d tesmektayem ara?
32:5: A d Iseyyi lameṛ seg igenni ar tmurt; sinna, ad iuɣal ɣuṛeS deg ibwass, lmudda s: agim iseggwasen, s leḥsab nnwen.
32:6: Akka, Umusnaw n wayen iffren, u n wayen ur neffir, Uzmir Iţḥunun.
32:7: I Iṣṣegmen akw ayen Ixleq. Inza d lxelq n umdan, si talaxt.
32:8: Sinna, Issuffeɣ ed tarwa s si lɣella, degs cwiṭ n waman.
32:9: Sinna, Imesl it, Iṣṣuḍ degs, si ṛṛuḥ iS. Irra yawen timesliwt, iẓṛi, ul. Drus ay tesnemmirem.
32:10: Nnan: "ma nweddeṛ di tmurt, day a d neţwaxleq tikelt nniḍen"? Xaṭi, nekṛen timlilit akked Mass nnsen.
32:11: Ini: "ad iddem ṛṛuḥ nnwen, lmelk n tmeţţant i iţţukelfen fellawen. Sinna, ar Mass nnwen a ţţuɣalem".
32:12: Lemmer a ţwaliḍ ibeɣwḍiyen, ad brun i iqweṛṛa nnsen, zdat Mass nnsen: "a Mass nneɣ! Nwala, nesla; Err aneɣ a nexdem ayen ilhan. S tideţ, numen".
32:13: Lemmer i ɣ ihwi, yili Nefka, i yal ṛṛuḥ, nnhaya s. Maca, ad iḍṛu wayen Nniɣ: "war ccekk, ad Acaṛeɣ Loahennama s leonun akked yimdanen, mejmulen".
32:14: Ihi, jeṛṛbet imi teţţum a d temlilem d wass nnwen agi! Nekwni, ih, Neţţu kwen. Jeṛṛbet aɛaqeb, n lebda, ilmend n wayen txeddmem.
32:15: I iumnen kan, s issekniyen nneɣ, d wid, mara ten id mmektin, ara weddin ad knun, ara isbucuɛen Mass nnsen s ccekṛan, nitni ur ţzuxxun.
32:16: Pţensaren d ibeṛdiyen nnsen, seg imṭeṛḥen, ţnujun ɣeṛ Mass nnsen, s tugwdi d usirem. Seg wayen iten Nɣat, ţseddiqen.
32:17: Ur iẓṛi yiwen acu i sen Ffreɣ n lfeṛḥ. D arraz n wayen llan xeddmen.
32:18: Win illan d lmumen, day am win illan d amedɣul? Ur aɛdilen.
32:19: Ihi, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, leonanat imṛaḥbiyen, ara zedɣen, ilmend n wayen xeddmen.
32:20: Wanag wid ideɣwlen, di tmes ara zedɣen. Yal tikelt ideg ara bɣun a d ffɣen segs, a ten rren ɣuṛes, ad asen inin: "jeṛṛbet aɛaqeb n tmes i tnekkṛem".
32:21: Ih, a Nessukk fellasen aɛaqeb aqṛib maḍi, war aɛaqeb abarar. Ahat a d uɣalen s abrid.
32:22: Anwa i idensen sennig n win iwumi d dekṛen issekniyen n Mass is, iuɣal iwexxeṛ asen? Ih, a d Nerr ţţaṛ seg ibeɣwḍiyen.
32:23: Niɣ Nefka yas Tazmamt i Musa. Ur ţţili di ccekk af temlilit yideS! Nerra ţ d nnhaya i At Isṛail.
32:24: Nesbedd, segsen, iselmaden; nnehun s lameṛ nneɣ, mi ṣebṛen, u llan ţţutebbten ɣef issekniyen nneɣ.
32:25: Ih, Mass ik, Neţţa, ad Iḥudd garasen, ass n tnekra, ɣef wayen iɣef mgarraden.
32:26: Day ur ten inha ara wayen Nesqucc isuta, uqbel nnsen? La leḥḥun ɣef tnezduɣin nnsen. Deg waya, s tideţ, issekniyen. Day ur sellen ara?
32:27: Day ur zṛin ara Neţţawi aman s akal aquṛan; Nessuffuɣ ed, yissen, iɛaqqayen; teţţen, segsen, nitni akked lmal nnsen. Day ur ţwalin ara?
32:29: Ini: "ass n lɣelb, liman n wid ijehlen, ur ten infaɛ; ur ţganin".
32:30: Ihi, wexxeṛ asen, ggani. Nitni, s tideţ, la ţganin.
33:1: A Nnbi! Ḥezzeb i Ṛebbi, ur ţţaɣ awal i ijehliyen akked ixabiten. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izga d Amusnaw, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
33:2: Ddu akked wayen i k d Iţţuweḥḥan, sɣuṛ Mass ik. Ih, Ṛebbi Iţţuxebbeṛ ɣef wayen txedmem.
33:3: Pţkel ɣef Ṛebbi. Iqadd Ṛebbi d Awkil.
33:4: Ur Irra ara Ṛebbi sin wulawen di tfekka n urgaz. Ur Irra ara tilawin nnwen, i tmetlem ar iɛrar n tyimmatin nnwen, d tiyimmatin nnwen. Ur irra ara wid id tessekrem, d tarwa nnwen. Ayagi, d awal nnwen, seg imawen nnwen. Ṛebbi Issawal tideţ. Neţţa Iţţawi d ubrid.
33:5: Ssiwlet asen am ibabaten nnsen; akka i iwqem ar Ṛebbi. Ma ur tessinen ara anwi ay d ibabaten nnsen, atmaten nnwen di ddin, d iqṛiben nnwen. Ur illi uɣilif ɣef wayen teffalṭam degs, siwa ayen ɛammden wulawen nnwen. Ṛebbi Izga Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
33:6: Nnbi iqṛeb ar lmumnin, sennig iman nnsen. Tilawin is, d tiyimmatin nnsen. Wid iţţemyilin, mqaṛaben di Tezmamt n Ṛebbi, sennig lmumnin akked iminigen. Siwa ma tgam tajmilt i imeddukwal nnwen. Ayagi iura di Tezmamt.
33:7: Mi Neṭṭef si lambiyya lmitaq nnsen, u si kečč, si Nuḥ, Ibṛahim, Musa, u si Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem, Neṭṭef segsen lmitaq lfayeq,
33:8: iwakken ad Iḥtec imawlan n tideţ, af tideţ nnsen. Ihegga d, i ijehliyen, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
33:9: A wid iumnen! Mmektit ed lɣit ikwen Iɣat Ṛebbi. Mi d usan ɣuṛwen iɛsekṛiwen, Nuzen asen d aḍu, akked iɛsekṛiwen ur twalam. Ṛebbi Izga Iţwali ayen txeddmem.
33:10: Mi wen d kkan sennig wen, seddawat wen, mi zzint wallen, ulawen bbwḍen s ijuxax, teţmeyyizem yal ameyyez ɣef Ṛebbi.
33:12: Mi d nnan ixabiten, akked imehzulen n wul: "ay ɣ d Iwaɛɛed Ṛebbi, akked Umazan iS, siwa aɣuṛṛu".
33:13: Mi d inna urbaɛ segsen: "a yAt Yatrib, ur illi umekkan i kunwi, uɣalet"! Kra segsen ssutren tsriḥ i Nnbi, nnan: "ih, ixxamen nneɣ aɛran". Nitni, ur llin aɛran, bɣan kan ad rewlen.
33:14: Ma kecmen ten id, si leriaf is, sinna, ssutren asen ad xubten, ad xubten. Cwiṭ kan ara kukrun fellas.
33:15: Niɣ llan ɛuhden s Ṛebbi, uqbel, ar ur ţţuɣalen ar deffir. Aɛahed s Ṛebbi ad iţţuqeṭṭi!
33:16: Ini: "ur kwen tenfaɛ trewla, ma trewlem si tmeţţant, neɣ si ṭṛad. Ara tezhum, siwa tallit wezzilen".
33:17: Ini: "anwa wa, ara kwen ikksen seg ufus n Ṛebbi, ma Ibɣa yawen cceṛṛ, neɣ Ibɣa yawen aḥunu"? Ur asen ţţafen, war Ṛebbi, bab, neɣ asettaṛ.
33:18: Niɣ Ṛebbi Iẓṛa wid degwen, i iţɛawwiqen, wid iqqaṛen i watmaten nnsen: "Yyat ɣuṛneɣ"! Drus kan degsen, i ikecmen ṭṛad.
33:19: D imceḥḥiyen ar loiha nnwen. Ma tusa d tugdi, a ten twaliḍ la k ţmuqulen, tezzint wallen nnsen, am win tessexciwit tmeţţant. Ma tekkes tugdi, a kwen gezren s yilsawen uqḍiɛen. D imceḥḥiyen ɣef lxiṛ. Wigi, ur uminen ara. Ihi, Imḥa Ṛebbi igiten nnsen. Ayagi, d ayen isehlen i Ṛebbi.
33:20: ɣilen ikabaren ur ṛuḥen ara. Lemmer a d asen ikabaren, ad ssirmen, ar nitni, di ṣṣeḥṛa ay llan, ar Waɛṛaben n ucluḥ, steqsayen fellawen. Lemmer llan yidwen, cwiṭ kan ara nnaɣen.
33:21: Niɣ, i kunwi, Amazan n Ṛebbi d amedya amxallef i win iţţaṛoun Ṛebbi, akked was aneggaru, id ismektayen aṭas Ṛebbi.
33:22: Mi walan lmumnin ikabaren, nnan: "ayagi d ayen i ɣ d Iwaɛɛed Ṛebbi, akked Umazan iS. Ṛebbi, akked Umazan iS, Ssawlen tideţ". Ay sen irna kan, siwa liman akked wannuz.
33:23: Ger lmumnin, llan irgazen i iṭṭfen deg wayen iɣef ɛuhden Ṛebbi. Garasen, wid iḥellen timeṛoiwt nnsen, garasen wid iţganin. Ur bedlen maḍi.
33:24: Iwakken ad Ikafi Ṛebbi imawlan n tideţ, ɣef tideţ nnsen, u ad Iɛaqeb ixabiten, ma ihwa yaS, neɣ ad asen Issuref. Ih, Ṛebbi Izga Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
33:25: Iẓẓaɛ Ṛebbi wid ijehlen, s iḥecciṛ nnsen. Ur ţţaddamen lxiṛ. Issuli Ṛebbi ṭṛad i lmumnin. Ṛebbi Izga d Uohid, d Uzmir.
33:26: Issers ed, si lebṛuj nnsen, wid i sen ifkan afus, seg wAt Tezmamt. Issekcem tugdi deg ulawen nnsen. Arbaɛ tenɣam ten, arbaɛ tḥebsem ten.
33:27: Irra kwen tweṛtem akal nnsen, ixxamen nnsen, ayla nnsen. D akal ur taɛfisem. Ih, Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci.
33:28: A Nnbi! Ini i tlawin ik: "maday tebɣamt tameddurt n ddunit, akked ccbuḥ is, yyamt a kwent ɣiteɣ, ad a kwent bruɣ, berru umɛin.
33:29: Ma illa tebɣamt Ṛebbi, Amazan iS, akked uxxam aneggaru, ihi, Ihegga d Ṛebbi, i tɛaṛḍiyin, segkwent, arraz ameqwṛaḥan".
33:30: A tilawin n Nnbi! Tid segkwent ara iawin abekkaḍ ufḍiḥ, a ţţeţţuɛaqeb berdayen. Ayagi d ayen isehlen i Ṛebbi.
